protocol.nfa_operator: separate nsys CUDA Graph node trace process
protocol.nfa_clean_e2e: separate process without nsys or torch.profiler
protocol.flashinfer_operator: separate nsys CUDA Graph node trace process; dense attention main+merge and KV append are classified separately
protocol.flashinfer_clean_e2e: one clean run per cell without nsys or torch.profiler; valid receipts are cached and skipped
protocol.speedup_definitions: pure attention = FI dense attention main+merge / NFA selected attention; attention path = FI dense attention main+merge / (NFA selector + selected attention); clean TPOT = FI clean end-to-end decode TPOT / NFA clean end-to-end decode TPOT
protocol.observer_effect: nsys Graph node tracing may perturb kernel time; never subtract profiled operator total from clean TPOT to infer host overhead
protocol.timing_metric: end-to-end decode TPOT, not pure attention latency
